*OSM for Cities*, initiated by [Vitor George][vitor], is a platform which enables users to explore data and automatically receive updates from OpenStreetMap.

![](osm-for-cities.jpg "")

The project is [open-source][repo], under the MIT license.

[vitor]: https://github.com/vgeorge
[repo]: https://github.com/osmforcities/osmforcities
